manifest.next_phase: Demand, patient flow and beds - not started

review_decision.authority: The user authorized Codex to review and finalize the design and requested complete Phase 3 implementation and verification.
method: Reviewed all 100 longitudinal encounter summaries across age, acuity, care setting, hospital, repeated visits, carry-in, long stay and adverse/censored outcomes.
Inspected detailed narrative/structured examples in journeys 1, 2, 3, 4, 5, 6, 26, 40, 53 and 100, covering all six inpatient pathways and both episodic symptom pathways.

Checked the complete independent clinical rule report, medication/code/reference scope and actual row/family accounting. Full software/rebuild/recovery acceptance is evaluated separately by the exit gate.
All generated notes are independently checked against a closed fact grammar, source availability, identity and structured values; this is not manual clinical review of every generated note.

findings_and_disposition.finding: Believable longitudinal variation and identity continuity
findings_and_disposition.detail: Chronic follow-up uses known history; episodic complaints vary. All accepted master rows and names remain preserved.
Linked ED/IPD episodes, unplanned returns, opening contexts, carry-ins, withheld therapy, transfers, terminal events and cutoff censoring are represented.
Names/ages, symptom/diagnosis context, scalar values, medication status and operative evidence are supported by available source facts. Birthday-aware review strata were checked.
Selected oral orders are label-bounded examples. Correlated but non-identical assays and persistent-illness/recovery states support the fictional pathway calibration.

More independent orders/measurements and fewer selected administrations than the planning family allocation; the unchanged 580000-event and all per-table/total envelopes pass. No quota padding or reserve consumption.

limitations: This is synthetic domain/data-design plausibility review, not licensed clinical endorsement or individual prescribing validation.
Selected non-exhaustive care capture excludes definitive glucose management, full pneumonia regimens, anesthesia, complete interactions/contraindications and comprehensive medication reconciliation.
Laboratory intervals, effects, cohort mix and LOS are fictional calibrated assumptions. The longer-stay inpatient surgical cohort is not a benchmark for routine day-case care or US prevalence.
Clinical encounter DEATH is authoritative even while registration.deceased_at is unknown; null is not survival.
Actual bed/staff/stock integration, financial reconciliation, source-delivery replay and final dataset acceptance remain later phase gates.
